messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — locking down sequencing & launch criteria for ElasticTenantRollout. Need alignment on runtime prewarm, infra provisioning, and security HSM/KMS gating. Can owners confirm timelines? Targeting soft launch in 3 weeks (cohort alpha -> beta -> GA).
Sam: Runtime notes — we need to enable prefix caching + per-tenant KV isolation. Est 10 dev-days to add tenant-aware cache eviction. Also need to test quantized 8-bit path for the 2.7B model. Will the infra pool be available? @Marta
Marta: Infra — provisioning dedicated pool (4x A10s) will take ~12 business days unless we can reuse existing reserve. HSM access request needs SOC docs. We could prewarm with shared pool for alpha if product ok. :thinking_face:
Jonathan (Security): Security: can't signoff on HSM until threat model + KMS key policy reviewed. Upload doc before EOD Wed. Also need to confirm audit retention for tenant keys.
Rachael: Ops: rollout cohorts idea — alpha(5 tenants), beta(20), GA(100+). Need canary rollback plan and alert thresholds. I'll own the rollout playbook.
Sam: For canary metrics, propose p99 latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%, token cost within 1.2x baseline. If violated, auto-roll back to hosted-variant. Example canary policy snippet:
```
canary_policy:
  window: 15m
  metrics:
    - p99_latency_ms: <200
    - error_rate_pct: <0.5
  rollback_on: [p99_latency_ms, error_rate_pct]
```
Elaine: Great. Owners/actions:
- Runtime: Sam -> tenant-aware cache + quant test (due in 10 days)
- Infra: Marta -> pool provisioning + HSM request (12 biz days)
- Security: Jonathan -> threat model + KMS policy (EOD Wed)
- Ops: Rachael -> rollout playbook + canary alerts (5 days)
If any owner needs to push, call it out now. Otherwise I'll book a 15-min sync tomorrow to confirm timelines.
DevOps-bot: Deployment template created: https://redwood.guru/infra/elastic-tenant-rollout-template (CI #4721)
Marta: If we reuse reserve pool for alpha, infra can shave ~5 days. Need product signoff on shared-pool fallback.
Elaine: Can product accept shared-pool fallback for alpha only? Pros: faster, less infra lead time. Cons: slightly higher noisy-neighbor risk. @Sam thoughts?
Sam: Shared-pool OK for alpha if we enable strict tenant cgroups + KV isolation and cap tokens per tenant. We'll add defensive throttles.
Jonathan (Security): Shared-pool acceptable for alpha if we enforce per-tenant encryption-in-transit and key scoping. I'll fast-track a short policy review if doc is ready.
Rachael: I'll draft the release checklist w/ rollback steps and SLA page. Ping me PRs for runbook.
Elaine: Thanks all. I'll update the project doc and post a 15-min sync invite. :thumbsup:
